title: Cherry Bomb
description: Noisy, blown-out punk-rap colliding with lush jazz-soul interludes; Tyler's messy, ambitious leap from shock-rap toward the producer he'd become.

title: Flower Boy
description: Sun-soaked, string-laden and lonely; warm neo-soul chords and gardening imagery frame a vulnerable coming-of-age and coming-out record.

title: IGOR
description: Fuzzy synth-funk breakup opera where Tyler mostly sings; distorted bass, soul samples and a story of obsessive, unrequited love.

title: CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST
description: Globetrotting, DJ Drama-hosted flex record: luxury travel bravado, jazz-soul loops and the heartbreaking ten-minute WILSHIRE.

title: CHROMAKOPIA
description: Theatrical, militaristic and introspective record about turning 33, his mother's advice, fatherhood anxiety and masks, with marching drums and lush choirs.

title: DON'T TAP THE GLASS
description: Short, sweaty, no-sitting-down dance record: Miami bass, funk and house-leaning grooves made strictly for moving, not overthinking.

title: Blonde
description: Hazy, minimalist guitar-and-organ R&B about memory, queer love and youth; ambient, intimate and often drumless, more dreamlike than rap.

title: At.Long.Last.A$AP
description: Psychedelic, druggy cloud-rap dedicated to A$AP Yams; woozy guitars, Danger Mouse grooves and syrupy, sauntering confidence.

title: TESTING
description: Experimental, deliberately unpolished fashion-rap lab: distorted samples, FKA twigs and Frank Ocean features, and genre detours that don't always land.

title: Rodeo
description: Dark, cinematic trap opera narrated by T.I.; auto-tuned ad-libs, Antidote and an apocalyptic, hazy Houston atmosphere.

title: Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight
description: Moody, nocturnal trap with goosebumps-inducing synths and auto-tuned melancholy; cold, atmospheric Houston drift featuring Kendrick, Cudi and Young Thug.

title: ASTROWORLD
description: Psychedelic trap theme park built on beat switches, booming 808s and auto-tuned hooks; SICKO MODE's three-part structure became its calling card.

title: UTOPIA
description: Dark, industrial, maximalist trap with Yeezus-like distortion, cavernous production and a parade of features.

title: Die Lit
description: Hypnotic, baby-voiced trap built on Pi'erre Bourne's glittery loops; repetitive, euphoric mosh-pit music more about vibe than lyrics.

title: Whole Lotta Red
description: Punk-vampire rage album of distorted synths, screamed vocals and chaotic energy that divided fans then defined a subgenre.

title: MUSIC
description: Sprawling, long-awaited 30-track odyssey mixing deep-voiced rage, ethereal melodies and big features; maximal, unpredictable and loud.

title: Until Death Call My Name
description: Raw Baton Rouge pain-rap: melodic, mournful hooks about paranoia, loyalty and violence, delivered with relentless emotional intensity.

title: Top
description: Chart-topping mix of piano-driven heartbreak ballads and aggressive street records; vulnerable confessions next to menacing threats.

title: The Life of Pablo
description: Chaotic, constantly-revised gospel-rap collage oscillating between church choirs, sample-heavy euphoria and messy, oversharing confessions.

title: KIDS SEE GHOSTS
description: Kanye and Kid Cudi's short psych-rock-rap record about mental health and healing; cathartic screams, Kurt Cobain samples and uplifting release.

title: Heaven or Hell
description: Smooth, psychedelic melodic trap from Travis's protégé; elastic falsetto hooks, lava-lamp synths and late-night cruising energy.

title: X
description: Opium-label rage: blaring, distorted synth leads and mumbled, hypnotic flows; pure adrenaline for mosh pits and fast driving.

title: A Great Chaos
description: Darker, glitchier rage record with blown-out 808s, industrial textures and the viral anthem ss; chaotic and nocturnal.

title: Eternal Atake
description: Spacey alien-abduction concept record of video-game synths, rapid-fire flows and euphoric melodies; bouncy, weird and hyperactive.

title: Gemini Rights
description: Lo-fi bedroom funk and psychedelic soul about messy breakups and bisexual longing; jangly guitars and the viral, bitter Bad Habit.

title: WASTELAND
description: Moody, cinematic toxic-R&B concept album; silky falsetto over hazy drums, skits about fame, guilt and a relationship falling apart.

title: NEVER ENOUGH
description: Tender, experimental soul with gospel roots; warm guitars and electronic shimmer around themes of insecurity and longing.

title: To Pimp a Butterfly
description: Dense jazz-funk and spoken-word epic about fame, Black identity and survivor's guilt, built around live bands and a poem unfolding across the tracklist.

title: GNX
description: Surprise-dropped West Coast victory lap with lowrider bounce, mariachi flourishes and the diss-anthem afterglow of Not Like Us.

title: HEROES & VILLAINS
description: Cinematic superhero-themed producer album with orchestral swells, dark trap and features from The Weeknd, Travis Scott and 21 Savage.
